contract.summary: Downlight Pro Planner is a premium responsive recessed lighting layout planner that creates, calculates, interactively edits, saves, reopens, prints and exports professional downlight plans with estimated lux results, warnings, task zones, exclusions and switching groups.

steps.expect: the Downlight Pro Planner landing screen is visible with a sign in control and a create account control

steps.action: create an account or sign in with email and password
steps.expect: the planner workspace is visible with a left controls panel, central plan canvas and right results panel
a blank project form is visible and the project name field is editable

steps.action: enter project name, room name, unit system, room shape, room dimensions, ceiling height, working-plane height and use type
steps.expect: the central plan canvas updates to show the room outline and dimension labels in the selected unit system

steps.action: choose a room preset and edit the target illuminance
steps.expect: the right results panel shows the selected use type, editable target lux and planning-estimate disclaimer

steps.action: enter fitting lumens, wattage, beam angle, colour temperature, fitting diameter, cut-out size and dimmable status
steps.expect: the fitting properties section shows the entered lumens, wattage, beam angle, colour temperature, size and dimmable value
a balanced arrangement of numbered downlights appears on the plan canvas with row spacing, column spacing and wall offset dimension labels

the panel displays room area, target lux, total lumen requirement, estimated number of fittings, installed lumens, estimated average illuminance, watts, watts per square metre, row spacing, column spacing, wall offsets and a plain-language explanation of the selected layout
a saved status is visible with the current project name

steps.action: reload the page and reopen the saved project
steps.expect: the reopened project shows the same room dimensions, fitting specification, downlight count, plan positions and calculated results after the reload

journeys.title: A signed-in user creates a project and generates an automatic downlight layout
acceptance: AUTO LAYOUT produces visible numbered fittings inside the room outline
the right panel shows calculation results labelled as planning/design estimates
a saved project can be reopened after a full browser reload with its fitting positions still visible

steps.expect: the plan canvas displays the saved room outline and downlight positions
the plan view visibly shows or hides the grid and dimension labels according to the toggles

steps.action: select a fitting on the plan
steps.expect: the selected fitting is highlighted and the right panel shows editable X and Y coordinate inputs in the selected unit system

steps.action: drag the selected fitting to a new location
steps.expect: the selected fitting moves to the new visible position and the spacing and calculation results update live

steps.action: edit the selected fitting coordinate inputs
steps.expect: the selected fitting moves to the typed coordinates and the displayed X and Y values match the new position
the visible fitting count and numbered markers update after each add, duplicate and delete action
the plan updates to the selected starting arrangement and the calculations panel refreshes
the fittings return to an automatically balanced arrangement with an updated layout explanation

journeys.title: A user adjusts fittings directly on the interactive plan
acceptance: dragging a fitting visibly changes its position on the plan
editing selected fitting coordinates visibly moves that fitting
adding or deleting fittings changes the visible fitting count and recalculated estimated lux

steps.expect: the saved plan is visible with the central plan canvas active

steps.action: add a rectangular task zone with a label and target lux
steps.expect: a labelled task zone rectangle is visible on the plan and the zone target lux is shown in the side panel

steps.action: add a rectangular exclusion zone with a label
steps.expect: a labelled no-light rectangle is visible on the plan

steps.action: run AUTO LAYOUT with the task and exclusion zones present
steps.expect: new fitting positions avoid the exclusion zone and the layout explanation mentions task lighting and exclusion-zone avoidance

steps.action: move a fitting into the exclusion zone
steps.expect: a warning appears stating that a fitting is inside an exclusion or no-light zone

steps.action: remove the task zone and exclusion zone
steps.expect: the task and exclusion rectangles disappear from the plan and the zone list is empty

journeys.title: A user adds task lighting zones and no-light exclusion zones
acceptance: task zones are drawn as labelled rectangles on the plan
exclusion zones are drawn as labelled no-light rectangles on the plan
a fitting placed inside an exclusion zone produces a visible warning without blocking editing

steps.expect: multiple numbered fittings are visible on the plan

steps.action: apply centre and perimeter group assignment
steps.expect: fittings display distinct group colours or labels for centre and perimeter groups

steps.action: select one fitting and assign it to a different group
steps.expect: the selected fitting changes to the chosen group colour or label

steps.action: switch from PLAN VIEW to HEAT MAP VIEW
steps.expect: the plan changes to a coloured estimated lux coverage heat map with a visible disclaimer that it is not certified photometric modelling
the standard top-down plan view returns with numbered fittings, dimensions and group labels visible

journeys.title: A user assigns switching groups and reviews estimated heat map coverage
acceptance: switching groups are visible as colours or labels on fitting markers
the heat map view displays estimated coverage colours
the heat map view includes a visible non-certified planning visualisation disclaimer

steps.expect: the project list and new project control are visible
the project header and project list show the new project name after saving
a second project appears in the project list with matching room dimensions and fitting count
the new preset name appears in the saved fitting presets list

steps.action: select the saved fitting preset for the project
steps.expect: the project fitting specification controls are populated with the preset values
the deleted preset name is no longer visible in the preset list
the deleted project is removed from the project list and cannot be opened
the sign in screen is visible and saved project names are not shown

journeys.title: A user manages saved projects and fitting presets
acceptance: renaming a project updates the visible project header and list entry
duplicating a project creates a separate visible project with matching room data
deleting a fitting preset removes it from the preset selector

steps.action: open a saved project with a completed layout
steps.expect: the finished plan, calculations and fitting schedule are visible

a printable plan view is visible with project name, room dimensions, scale or diagram, fitting positions, dimension lines, fitting specification, number of fittings, target lux, estimated lux, notes and switching groups
a downloadable SVG export is offered and the export status message says SVG plan ready
a downloadable PNG export is offered and the export status message says PNG plan ready
a downloadable JSON project file is offered and the export status message says JSON project ready

steps.action: export the fitting schedule as CSV
steps.expect: a downloadable CSV fitting schedule is offered and the schedule table shows quantity, wattage, lumens, colour temperature, cut-out size, diameter, dimmable status and switching group counts

journeys.title: A user prints and exports a finished lighting plan
acceptance: the print view displays the project name, plan diagram and calculation summary
the CSV schedule visibly includes fitting quantity and switching group counts
each export control shows a ready status message for its file type

steps.action: open the planner at desktop width
steps.expect: the interface shows a left controls panel, central plan canvas and right results panel on one row
the plan canvas remains full width and the controls and results panels are available as collapsible sections
there is no horizontal page overflow and the plan view, controls and results are accessible by scrolling or collapsible panels

journeys.title: A user can operate the planner on tablet and mobile without horizontal overflow
acceptance: desktop layout visibly uses three main workspace columns
tablet layout uses collapsible panels with a full-width plan view
mobile layout has no horizontal overflow

routes.name: Planner
routes.purpose: Authenticated landing and main Downlight Pro Planner workspace with project controls, plan canvas, calculations, warnings, schedules and export controls.

routes.name: Print View
routes.purpose: Printable PDF-style plan view for the currently selected saved project.

entities.name: project
relationships: a project may use one saved fitting preset by selectedFittingPresetName
a project contains many fitting positions in fittings
a project contains many task zones in taskZones
a project contains many exclusion zones in exclusionZones
a project contains many switching groups in switchingGroups

entities.name: fittingPreset
relationships: a fitting preset can be selected by a project and copied into the project's fittingSpec

auth.model: email + password via the backend SDK
rules: a signed-out visitor sees the authentication screen instead of the project list
a signed-in user only sees projects and fitting presets they own
after sign out, saved project names and fitting preset names are not visible

operations.description: persist a new lighting project via db.entity('project').create with room data, fitting specification, empty or generated layout data and calculation settings
persist project edits via db.entity('project').update including layout, dimensions, fitting positions, zones, groups, warnings and calculation settings
read owned saved projects via db.entity('project') and display the selected project in the planner
delete an owned saved project via db.entity('project').delete and remove it from the visible project list
create a separate owned project record by copying the current project's room, specification, positions, zones, groups and settings
calculate and save a balanced arrangement in the project's fittings, calculationResults and layoutExplanation fields
persist a reusable fitting preset via db.entity('fittingPreset').create
delete an owned fitting preset via db.entity('fittingPreset').delete and remove it from the selector
render a printable plan view from the selected saved project data
generate a client-side SVG plan drawing from the selected project
generate a client-side PNG plan drawing from the selected project canvas or SVG
generate a downloadable JSON project file from the selected project record
generate a downloadable CSV fitting schedule from the selected project record

integrations.name: backend SDK auth
integrations.purpose: authenticate users with auth.signUp, auth.signIn, auth.signOut and auth.currentUser

integrations.name: backend SDK database
integrations.purpose: persist projects and fitting presets with db.entity('project') and db.entity('fittingPreset')

states.empty: no account session message with sign in and create account controls
states.loading: signing in message while authentication is pending

states.empty: no projects yet message with a new project button
states.error: could not load projects message is visible
states.success: saved project names are visible in the list
states.validation: project name is required before saving

states.empty: blank new project form is visible
states.error: layout could not be calculated message is visible
states.loading: calculating layout message while auto layout runs
states.success: room outline and generated fittings are visible on the plan
states.validation: length, width, ceiling height, working-plane height, target lux and lumens must be positive numbers

states.empty: empty room outline with no fittings is visible before layout generation
states.error: invalid fitting position warning is visible
states.loading: plan loading placeholder is visible while project data is read
states.success: numbered fittings, dimensions, zones and group labels are visible
states.validation: selected fitting coordinate must stay within the editable plan bounds

states.empty: no calculation yet message is visible before required inputs are complete
states.loading: recalculating message is visible after layout changes
states.success: area, lumens, fitting count, estimated lux, wattage and spacing results are visible
states.validation: estimated under target lux and high lux warnings appear when thresholds are exceeded

states.empty: no warnings message is visible when no issues are detected
states.error: warning calculation unavailable message is visible
states.loading: checking layout message is visible while warnings update
states.success: warnings are visible but editing controls remain enabled
states.validation: warnings appear for large spacing, close fittings, poor wall offset, under target lux, high estimated lux, fitting in exclusion zone, asymmetry and beam coverage gaps

states.empty: no saved fitting presets message is visible
states.error: could not save fitting preset message is visible
states.success: saved preset appears in the preset list
states.validation: preset name, lumens, wattage, beam angle, colour temperature, diameter and cut-out size are required

states.empty: complete a layout before exporting message is visible
states.success: ready status message is visible for the selected export type
states.validation: export controls are disabled until the project has at least one fitting

acceptance.statement: after AUTO LAYOUT, the plan canvas displays numbered downlight markers inside the room outline
the calculations panel displays room area, target lux, total lumen requirement, installed lumens, estimated average illuminance, watts per square metre and spacing values
a project saved in the browser is visible with the same project name, dimensions and fitting positions after a full page reload
dragging or coordinate-editing a selected fitting visibly changes its position and updates the estimated lux result
placing a fitting inside an exclusion zone shows a visible warning and does not disable plan editing
heat map view shows coloured estimated coverage and a visible statement that it is not certified photometric modelling
the print view visibly includes project name, room dimensions, diagram, fitting positions, dimensions, fitting specification, target lux, estimated lux, notes and switching groups
on a mobile-width viewport the page has no horizontal overflow and the plan view remains usable with collapsible controls

deferred.reason: the app provides estimated planning visualisation only and does not import manufacturer photometric files or perform standards-certified lighting simulation

deferred.item: electrical cable sizing and protective-device design
deferred.reason: the requested scope explicitly excludes electrical circuit design beyond visual switching group assignment

deferred.item: raw HTTP integrations or third-party export services
deferred.reason: the fixed scaffold only permits the provided backend SDK and client-side browser exports
the export requirement is satisfied by a printable PDF-style browser print view without adding server-side PDF tooling
the planner exports practical SVG, PNG, JSON and CSV files but does not implement DWG, DXF or BIM exchange
